notes.title: Wayfinder Mods Now in Beta!
notes.notes:
[p]Wayfinder now supports player-made mods through [url="https://mod.io/"]Mod.io[/url]! Download the special branch "mods_beta" which will grant you access to browsing and managing mods from the main menu in Wayfinder. Get new mounts, restructure Lost Zones, create new experiences and share them with community. [/p][p][/p][p][b]How to Download the Wayfinder Mods Branch in Steam[/b][/p][p]Right click Wayfinder in your game library and select PROPERTIES.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/e2b4bb172d7be485c99719defa048345062d8392.png"][/img][/p][p]From here you can navigate to BETAS, and select "mods_beta - Mods Beta" from the list of versions.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/efe9a9d089dc1847f12b0bc8723fc2eca3fb4c66.png"][/img][/p][p]Once you have downloaded this version of the game and begin play, you will see a new option in the main menu - "MODS".[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/c656478b42cf354c136d6fdb54c72aa6dae92d83.png"][/img][/p][p]This menu will allow you to browse from a library of player-made mods supported by this version of Wayfinder. Simply SUBSCRIBE to the mod you want! [i]Further instructions can be found in the game.[/i] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/0017b17630c3de1a6da50ddc1cc7ff94a4aa80eb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]How to Create Custom Mods for Wayfinder in Unreal Engine[/b]

Want to create your own content for Wayfinder? Whether it’s new zones, mounts, enemies, or items, this guide walks you through how to build and share your custom creations using [url="https://mod.io/"]Mod.io[/url] and Unreal Engine—no coding required (but if you want it, go nuts!).

[b]Getting Started[/b]
[/p][p]Download the [url="https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/wayfinder-mod-editor-c10edb"]Wayfinder Mod Editor[/url] from the Unreal Game Store.[/p][p][/p][p]Most Wayfinder mods involve creating or modifying [i]all[/i] assets like Blueprints, Maps, Meshes, or other visual elements. Once you've made your changes, you’ll:
[/p][list][*][p]Cook your content in Unreal Engine.
[/p][/*][*][p]Package it into a `.pak` file.
[/p][/*][*][p]Upload it to [url="https://mod.io/"]mod.io[/url] to share it with the community!
[/p][/*][/list][p]
Doing so does require downloading the editor which is available on the Epic Game Store: 

[i]Note: If your mod includes game data like item stats or enemy info, you’ll need to follow a few extra steps listed below.[/i]

[b]Pro Tip:[/b] Instead of editing existing files directly, try copying them and making your changes in a new folder. This keeps things clean and avoids conflicts with other mods.

[b]Packaging Your Mod[/b]

After you've created your custom content:

1. Head to [b]Project Settings > Packaging > Additional Asset Directories to Cook[/b] and add all your new/changed folders.
2. (Optional) Speed up the process by excluding folders you didn’t touch.
3. Click [b]File > Cook Content for Windows[/b] in Unreal.
4. Find your cooked content here:
[/p][code]{ProjectName}/Saved/Cooked/WindowsNoEditor/Atlas/Content[/code][p]5. Recreate the correct folder path (e.g., `Atlas/Content/EverythingLostZone`) to match the game’s structure.
6. Name the folder: `[b]Atlas-WindowsNoEditor_{ModName}_P[/b]`
7. Use [url="https://github.com/RiotOreO/unrealpak"]unrealpak.exe[/url] to compress it into a `.pak` file.


[b]Mods That Add New Enemies, Items, or Zones[/b]

Mods that include gameplay data (like items, enemies, or new areas) need a little extra setup.

Before uploading your `.pak` to Mod.io:
[/p][list][*][p]Create a `[b]ModConfig.ini[/b]` file in the same folder as your `.pak`.
[/p][/*][*][p]Inside that file, list the new data tables you created.
[/p][/*][*][p]Only include [b]new tables[/b]—existing ones can't be edited this way.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Supported Table Types:[/b]
[/p][list][*][p][b]InventoryTables[/b] – for new items
[/p][/*][*][p][b]MutatorTables[/b] – for gameplay modifiers
[/p][/*][*][p][b]EnemySetTables[/b] – for new enemy types
[/p][/*][*][p][b]TravelInfoTables[/b] – for custom Lost Zones
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Example ModConfig.ini:[/b]
[/p][code]
\[/Script/Wayfinder.WFGameSettings]
InventoryTables=/Game/BonusMountsMod/Data/AirshipMod_MountItems.AirshipMod_MountItems
InventoryTables=/Game/BonusMountsMod/Data/AirshipMod_MountMeshes.AirshipMod_MountMeshes
TravelInfoTables=/Game/EverythingLostZoneMod/Everything_TravelInfoTable.Everything_TravelInfoTable
[/code][p]
If you're changing animations or skeletons (like with mounts), make sure your mod recreates the folder structure of the original game. You don’t need every file—just the folders.


[b]Upload and Share[/b]

Once your `.pak` file (and optionally ModConfig.ini) is ready, you can upload your mod to [url="https://mod.io/g/wayfinder"]mod.io/g/wayfinder[/url] and start sharing it with the Wayfinder community!

Whether you’re dreaming up a spooky new Lost Zone or building your own custom mount, we can’t wait to see what you create.
[/p]

notes.title: Difficulty Rewards & Save Slots - Quality of Life Update Preview
notes.notes:
Wayfinders,

We wanted to give a quick update on the rest of 2024!

We realize it has taken longer than anticipated to get the Xbox version of the game out and we appreciate your patience! Our goal is for the game, along with the Critical Role Supporter Pack, to be available by end of the year. We’re excited to welcome Wayfinders on the Xbox Series X|S, who will be playing with Wayfinders across the other platforms and when we have a release date, we’ll share it. 

As 2024 winds down, we’re preparing another major update that brings some highly requested features from players. The 1.1 update, expected in December, will include:

[list]
[*] Save Slots
[*] Nightmare Difficulty & exclusive cosmetic rewards
[*] New collectible items from our previous holiday event
[*] New artifacts
[*] Bug fixes, and other improvements.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/1541b5dc5d662b77e12913a8e6b9146bf33f4cd0.png[/img]

Nightmare is a new difficulty setting even tougher than Heroic, and with it introduces one of the most requested features: rewards for completing ultimate challenges at the highest difficulty level! These rewards persist across all save slots once they’re unlocked in Nightmare mode, applying to both existing and new save files. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/f0689748a9de43d3e4cce9faf1ab7b2309c8ae81.png[/img]

The challenges offer rewards like dyes, personas, and housing items that grant crafting resources like Spectra and Archaic Bones, along with memory fragments and gold. Over 35 new items are available for those who complete all challenges, including a special reward for those who complete every challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/5255987a36bd9ea8da6eac926c90224ccb95ee34.png[/img]

Nightmare Difficulty is only available when starting a New Game and cannot be changed once selected. However, it comes with enhanced drops, including empowered versions of all existing artifacts and three new artifacts exclusive to Nightmare difficulty. The ultimate min/maxer’s challenge awaits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/9a4dce4b8428ddb5e33a9c8267d7332318f10a0a.png[/img]

We’ve previously announced mods coming before the end of the year. With our timeline and focus on these other platforms and features, mods won’t be coming before the end of the year. We’ll share more details about the 1.1 update in the coming weeks! Keep an eye on our social channels for sneak peeks of these exciting new features.

notes.title: Wayfinder (PC) Review
notes.notes:
About a year ago, I had the opportunity to play an early access build of Wayfinder in development by Airship Syndicate. On its initial early access release, Wayfinder was presented as a free-to-play online-only co-op-focused MMORPG-lite. At the time, while the base systems felt solid and the combat had potential, many were concerned about typical F2P title woes such as microtransactions, paywalls, and the like.

This was before the original publisher backed out of the development process, leaving Airship Syndicate with a tough choice: close it all down or reimagine their hard work and investment as something new. Wayfinder 1.0 is the culmination of that reimagining. With Wayfinder 1.0, gone is the focus on online-only play, micro-transactions and the MMORPG-lite structures and what remains is an online/offline single-player/co-op Action RPG.

notes.title: Wayfinder x Critical Role
notes.notes:
With the release of Wayfinder Echoes, we were thrilled by the community's overwhelming response. Many players asked how they could support the studio. We said: spread the word. Gift copies. But ultimately, we wanted to offer a special way for players to support us directly.

We knew that if we were to offer something for purchase outside the game, explicitly intended to support us, it needed to be special. We wanted a partner who had walked in our shoes—someone who understands the challenge of fully funding and bringing to life a world they love. We found the perfect partner in [b]Critical Role[/b], who shares our passion for creating and funding a beloved world with the help of a dedicated community!

Here’s an early sneak peek at some of the content coming in this exciting pack!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/61b2158a095d45d1b369cee0a25aaf4fe64c712f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/1e41551caa236dfa290af34af8ea64de4e3e78da.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/4879a02954a3e14312c0b600dc7e9e765ae1f6ad.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/0710ecb13890e4bde483c4b8c61ed0d9679daf70.png[/img]

“We are huge fans of Critical Role, so we’re super excited for this collaboration, which we hope is the first of many,” said Joe Madureria, CEO of Airship Syndicate. “If players love this Supporter Pack, we’d love to make more--with Critical Role, and other IP’s in the future!”

“We want to continue to find fun and unique ways to interact with and explore Exandria,” Shaunette DeTie, Critical Role’s Licensing Manager said. “Seeing the creative team at Airship bring elements from Vox Machina to life in Wayfinder has been such a treat for the entire Critical Role team and we hope that players find this collab as cool and enjoyable as we do.”

This pack will go live with Wayfinder’s [b]1.0 launch on October 21, 2024[/b]. This pack is entirely optional and directly supports [b]Airship Syndicate[/b] and [b]Critical Role’s[/b] incredibly dedicated and talented teams. Players can purchase it outside the game, and directly from Steam or the PlayStation Store for [b]$19.99 USD[/b]. It includes:

[h2]Wayfinder - Critical Role Supporter Pack[/h2]
This pack comes packed with items and includes:
[list]
[*]4 Character Personas, including:
[list]
[*]Grendel as Grog Strongjaw
[*]Niss as Vax’ildan
[*]Venomess as Vex’ahlia
[/list]
[*]1 Trinket Mount & Saddle
[*]4 Character Charms
[*]15 Housing Items
[*]10 Sprays
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/2820540e02e85a49832b04fa86e4022daf697cd4.png[/img]

This pack wouldn’t have happened without our incredible community seeking ways to support our dedicated team that have poured their hearts into Wayfinder – especially over the last 6 months as we transitioned to the Echoes Update. We’re proud of Wayfinder and the work we’ve done as an independent developer and publisher, and we’re grateful for those that support our journey.

In the future, we’ll be working to bring additional Supporter Packs to Wayfinder with the same philosophy above—unique and cool cosmetic collaborations with other IPs, not sold in-game so as not to pressure players into feeling a sense of requirement to purchase. We aren’t quite ready to announce exactly what they are, but if you’re familiar with Airship’s body of work, you can make some pretty educated guesses as to what’s in store…

notes.title: QoL 2 Update & The Homestretch to 1.0!
notes.notes:
[h2]Wayfinder x Critical Role [/h2]

Besides our exciting Critical Role collaboration we [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1171690/view/4607833411866577817]announced today[/url] which will bring the characters and world of Vox Machina to Wayfinder, we're also pleased to announce that [b]Quality of Life Update 2 is LIVE![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/f91b670b784d313dc26b2a57eb96e7b205ce559f.png[/img]

[h2]Quality of Life 2[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/8792105fac3ba518b191846fdc94a00a42b54d7e.png[/img]
We’re excited to announce that Quality of Life Update 2 (QoL2) is [b]LIVE NOW[/b] for both Steam and PlayStation 5! We are so excited to finally welcome our PlayStation players back to the world of Evenor and incredibly grateful for their patience in this complicated transition. This update will bring a host of new features and improvements, and will be the final update as Wayfinder prepares for the 1.0 release.

[h2]Multiplayer Features[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Discord Invites:[/b] Steam players can now invite players to join your game directly through Discord, making it easier than ever to team up for quests and adventures. Simply create an open Discord invite, share it with your community, send an invite via Discord DM, or request to join by right-clicking a player’s username in Discord!
[*][b]Lobby Browser:[/b] The Lobby Browser feature has also undergone some under the hood upgrades and will be available for both PlayStation 5 and Steam Players! Customize your search criteria to find the perfect match for your play style or join random games for a spontaneous adventure. We’ve heard players want a quick way to get into lobbies with friends. We’re excited to share that with the release of 1.0 we’ll have lobby codes for quick and easy invites. 
[*][b]In-Game Chat:[/b] Communication is key in Wayfinder, and we’re adding in-game chat to help you strategize and socialize with ease. Whether you’re coordinating tactics or just catching up with friends, you’ll have more ways to stay connected.
[/list]

[h2]Housing Expansion[/h2]
With hundreds of free housing collectables found throughout the world of Evenor, it’s about time you have enough space to show them off! In QoL 2, we’ve expanded the housing system! Personalize your in-game home like never before with a new multi-story apartment, featuring many rooms, vaulted ceilings, and an airy balcony to take in the breathtaking views of Skylight. Your house will become a true reflection of your creativity, adventure, and achievements.

[h2]World Scaling[/h2]
In response to player feedback, we’ve added the option for world scaling to ensure a balanced experience across all areas of the game. This feature will adjust the level of enemies, difficulty of encounters, and level of loot based on your current level.

[h2]Improved Melee Combat Control[/h2]
Based on feedback, we’ve made significant improvements to melee combat control, enhancing responsiveness and precision. Players will notice full freedom of direction of all attacks for the full animation of their swings, all the way up to impact. Expect smoother and more fluid melee interactions, making it easier to land your attacks and execute combos effectively and removing some of the frustrating feelings of just missing a target that may have moved at the last second.

[h2]Improved Performance & UI Customization Options[/h2]
We’re focused on optimizing performance and providing more customization and accessibility options for the user interface. Enjoy faster load times, reduced first-time shading stutters, as well as new settings to customize your performance and tailor your UI to your preferences.

[b]A few of the new features include:[/b]
[list]
[*]Enable or disable Shadows
[*]Enable or disable Ambient Occlusion
[*]Enable or disable Post Processing
[*]Enable or disable Screen Shake
[*]Hide HUD
[*]Zoom to Cursor for pannable menus
[*]Travel Countdown Timer for Co-op
[*]Inventory Sorting Filters
[*]Quick access to Resonance Caches for Wayfinders in the Character Menu
[/list]

[h2]Steam Sale[/h2]
Quality of Life 2 is a great time for new Wayfinders to jump in! On Steam, Wayfinder is currently on sale for its lowest price ever! Grab the game now to join the adventure and experience all the exciting updates firsthand. The sale is live on Steam from September 9th - September 16th.

[h2]PlayStation 5 releases today[/h2]
We’re thrilled to confirm that Wayfinder has officially released on PlayStation 5 with this update! Wayfinder has returned to the PlayStation Store, and for the first time ever, PlayStation 5 players can finally experience a whole new way to play, with the Wayfinder Echoes Update! Console players can now join the adventure with overhauled progression systems, tons of content, and performance optimizations tailored for the PS5. As is the case with all players returning since the Echoes update, progress from the live service version of the game is incompatible with Wayfinder Echoes, but all Founder Items and the Runesilver make-good will automatically be granted shortly after completing the first Codex Halls Tutorial Expedition.

[h2]1.0 Release Date & Beyond[/h2]
Finally, we’re excited to announce that Wayfinder will launch into 1.0 on [b]October 21st, 2024[/b] on Steam and PlayStation 5, with a release on Xbox Series X|S and Epic Games Store in the following weeks!

It’s been a long road to get to 1.0, but we’re incredibly excited about the future of Wayfinder thanks to the awesome reception from the community. 1.0 will bring the largest update to Wayfinder and include the following:

[list]
[*]A brand new Wayfinder
[*]A brand new open world area
[*]2 brand new Lost Zones
[*]6 brand new weapons
[*]New mounts, skins, housing items and more!
[/list]

We’ve said from the announcement of Echoes that Wayfinder’s future past 1.0 will be decided by the players who purchase and support the game.

[b] Following the 1.0 release, we’re planning another major update and we’re excited to confirm today that one of the features will be full mod support on PC for specific save files. [/b] With Mods, regardless of any additional content we may add, the game will continue to exist and thrive in the hands of the community. We’ve also heard that players want to directly support us and the development of Wayfinder outside of purchasing copies for friends and word of mouth. We’re humbled, but also committed to what we had said at the launch of Wayfinder Echoes – there will be no in-game microtransactions, but we’re looking at other ways for players to help support the game.

Wayfinder 1.0 will be here soon, and we’re excited for those who have been waiting for it on all platforms to finally jump in and experience the revamped action RPG. We believe this new version of the game is better than its predecessor, and with the changes we have planned, will set it up for success for years to come.

notes.title: Quality of Life Update 1 - Server Browser Is Live!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Quality of Life Update 1[/b]
[/h1]

As always, we want to thank our incredible players for supporting us and helping us make an incredible game. This first quality of life patch has tons of changes based on feedback and bug reports from the community. We'll be releasing another quality of life patch in the future as we work towards 1.0 which will contain new content. 


[h2][b]Major New System - Party Finder [/b]
[/h2]
The Find Party option is our take on a server browser, and was the number one most requested feature when we announce Echoes and we’re excited to get it into player’s hands. This allows you to find games with the activities you want to do, at the level you want to do them and more! We’re labeling this current iteration as alpha as there is room for improvement and we do recommend players back up their data just in case. We’ll be looking at your feedback and making changes to the browser for our next quality of life patch which will move the browser from alpha to beta.  

A few things to note.

[list]
[*] The game you connect to remains peer-to-peer, just like if you were to join a friend. This is not a dedicated server.

notes.title: Patch Preview: Quality of Life Update 1
notes.notes:
This upcoming patch will be the first large update to Wayfinder since the Echoes Update. While this update will have no new playable content (that’s coming with 1.0, so stay tuned!), we wanted to share what players can expect from our first “polish pass” as we work towards console release followed by leaving Early Access later this year. This patch is scheduled for mid July and as soon as we have a final date we'll share it!

[h2]Server Browser
[/h2]
By far our most requested feature when we relaunched Wayfinder was an easy way to get into a game with friends or yet-to-be friends! We’re excited to announce that we’re rolling out the Server Browser alpha in this update!

The server browser allows you to jump quickly into games based on criteria you set. Want to level your level 10 Niss by just Hunt farming? Or maybe you’re starting a brand new playthrough and want a co-op partner for the story and quests. The browser allows you to filter and customize the play experience you want to have. If you want to throw caution to the wind and jump into a random match, you can do that too!

The Server Browser has gone through various testing internally and externally, but there are risks involved with save states and data, so we’ll be labeling it alpha as we fine-tune it and adjust based on player feedback.

[previewyoutube=cb9We4DVNZQ;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Discord Invites
[/h2] 
[h3][i]Please Note: This feature will be enabled at a later date.
[/i][/h3]
With Discord invites, you can send invites directly to friends old and new, as well as host a party and allow others to join directly. In the Wayfinder Discord and want to get some people to help take on The First? No problem, simply create an open Discord invite, post it to the channel, and people can instantly jump into your session without having to exchange Steam friend requests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/6a04e0e0168bfb0fa52908647242d3a380b9ab86.png[/img]

[h2]Combat and Movement Updates
[/h2]We’ve made quite a few small tweaks across the board for Wayfinders, specifically in combat and when moving in the air. We’ve adjusted the control that players have of their character in-air to make it more responsive and hopefully cut down on missing ledges or jumping puzzles. There are plenty of healthy buffs to characters such as Senja and Kyros, but we also made some changes that’ll impact all Wayfinders. We’ve improved the smart targeting of enemies, reduced camera issues when locked on, and more, making it so that no matter what character you play, you’ll see an improvement in the moment-to-moment combat.
[previewyoutube=-n8ky_t7swg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Loot & Progression[/h2]
Players have been very clear - the new loot system we have is awesome, but we can make it even better! This patch brings two very welcome changes! The first is that you will now see resources at the Gloomsphere that will appear in your expeditions, making it super easy to know what your adventures will bring when it comes to maximizing your farm game! The second is that the armor loot pool is now additive, meaning once you’ve exhausted the loot pool for the area you’re in, you will start to receive lower-tier armor you might be missing from previous zones. Additional highlights include enabling the selling of craftable housing items and adding more spectra to Frostmarch!
[previewyoutube=i5yojp6_uZ0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Extended Options & Player Settings[/h2]
We’re also allowing players to remap more hotkeys, adjust the camera distance on the controller, and use an FOV slider to really get close to the action. We’ll continue to add additional settings for players to tweak both accessibility and fine tune performance throughout early access. 
[previewyoutube=nWlseU7ZF8o;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Environmental Fixes
[/h2]We’ve gone ahead and updated over 100 tiles and locations in-game to reduce getting stuck on random objects on the floor and made ledge grabbing more consistent. The previously mentioned movement changes when in the air also make traversal less frustrating. We’ll continue to make adjustments and changes to areas in the world to ensure there is no friction when traveling.

[h2]Future Quality of Life Updates
[/h2]We’ve heard discussions about our combat being “stiff” at times, and we feel that there is room to improve, specifically when it comes to animations when attacking. Look for these changes, an upgraded house, and our Beta iteration of the Server Browser feature in a future quality of life patch in Early Access, followed by our large content update including a new Wayfinder and new zones at the 1.0 release later this year.

notes.title: Wayfinder Echoes is Live!
notes.notes:
Founders!

[h2]Welcome to the Wayfinder Echoes Update!
[/h2]

[h1]What is The Echoes Update?
[/h1]
When online games such as Wayfinder reach the end of their service, they tend to disappear forever. This is the unfortunate reality when games lose funding, can't cover the costs of servers or staff, and face countless other challenges.

Having all played titles that have gone through this cycle, we wanted to take a different approach. We cherish the world our team has created and the characters we've introduced to our players, and we don't want them to be lost in the Gloom. Our goal is to leave players with a product they can enjoy indefinitely.

This shift enables the game to exist perpetually. Players can download it to play solo or enjoy co-op gameplay with up to two friends.


Before leaving Early Access and releasing to 1.0, we'll introduce Matchmaking, a new Wayfinder, a new zone, housing expansion and many more features. The future beyond that is up to you, the player. We love Wayfinder, we love the world, and we love the IP and we'll continue to grow it if we're able to with your support! 
 

Wayfinder Echoes introduces significant changes from the previous version of Wayfinder, [b]No previous data is carried over to this new game.[/b] Below, we've outline outlined the biggest changes.

notes.title: Announcing Wayfinder Echoes - Forging Our Own Path
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/342c9b793b321273b225006291e9320ccdd7114e.png[/img]

[h3]Wayfinders,

As previously mentioned, upon initiating the transfer of service from Digital Extremes to Airship Syndicate, the team began thinking long-term. How do we go about improving Wayfinder while keeping the game alive forever in a sustainable way?[/h3]


[h2]Removal of Online Requirements.
[/h2]
[b]Wayfinder will be removing all online requirements and will be a single-player game with optional 3-player co-op.[/b] No queues, no login, no accounts. You can choose to play solo on your Steam Deck while on the go or engage in peer-to-peer co-op with friends from your home PC. We realize this is a big shift, but a necessary one to guarantee that the game is around forever.[b] This also means that all progress will not be carried forward due to saves being local and not on a server.[/b] This major change will be the basis for what we’re calling Wayfinder's Echoes Update.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/233f75ad88727701ce716033ab4c9170d69f094c.png[/img]


[h2]One Price, not microtransactions.
[/h2]
Removing the online requirement wasn’t our only major change. The industry has also shifted in recent years. With more and more games coming out, they’re all fighting for player’s time and attention. Players have more to play than ever, and they’re being asked to log into multiple games to check their daily quests, look at a store rotation, and be drip-fed content. Players today are more apt to outright purchase a game they know is full of content and also respectful of their time. In the Echoes Update, we’ll be charging one price—$24.99 USD during Early Access (increasing upon full release). [b]No in-game microtransactions or in-game purchases, just one price. [/b]Founders who have already purchased the game will have access, and all the exclusive items included in each pack. Our Founder’s Packs will not be going back on sale. For anyone that supported us by purchasing in-game Runesilver, we’ve converted that Runesilver into a new in-game currency used to acquire exclusive cosmetics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/98166ebc4bdaf31d8584b176538d58dcf17d0572.png[/img]

[h2]Major Gameplay Changes.
[/h2]
These aren’t the only changes, though. We’ve touched every major system in the game, and as a result, the gameplay is not only more refined, but through our various playtests with those outside the studio, the game performs and plays better than before. Some of these changes include all weapons becoming randomized drops with various slots, armor now having stats and being collectible, thousands of cosmetics and housing items available to collect, the removal of the grind to get new characters, eased requirements for awakening characters, increased housing item limits, adding four difficulties to choose from, incorporating traditional RPG talents into your progression, and much more. This update will also launch with the latest Wayfinder: Grendel, as well as brand-new Hunts and a new Overlands zone (three times the size of our last!) that’s overflowing with content and points of interest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/59eaddb04ded1dfe662bc1cd8d2dff5606ffc587.png[/img]

[h2]When Can I Play? 
[/h2] 
While we have lots more to share on these changes in the coming weeks, we have always felt that actions speak louder than words. Therefore, we’ll be soft launching Wayfinder Echoes’ changes on May 31st. From that point forward, all online requirements tied to Steam, including all player data, will be removed, and the game will be available for anyone that currently owns any version of Wayfinder on Steam. [b]Wayfinder will once again be available for purchase on Steam in Early Access on June 11th. [/b]These changes will come to PlayStation 5 later in the year, and we’ll keep players updated once we have a concrete timeline. PlayStation 4 support will be discontinued, with all PS4 versions being upgraded to PS5 at no additional cost. In the meantime, PlayStation 4 and 5 players can continue to access the game as normal. Relaunching in Early Access on a single platform also allows us to be agile and make changes at a faster pace than before. We plan to leave Early Access later in 2024, but during that time, we’ll be adding gameplay refinements based on feedback, a new Wayfinder, a new location to explore, new expanded housing, and more. We’re also formally announcing that Wayfinder will be coming to Xbox Series X|S during Early Access, and we’ll provide an update on timing later in the year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/8ce7b13ac4034822d3892a9f7dad2655f8fac621.png[/img]


[h2]The Path Ahead.
[/h2]
We know that the path to get here hasn’t been easy, and the game has had a rocky past. We also know that this wasn’t the original game that we envisioned or that our fans bought into. When faced with the reality of where we are, we saw our options as shuttering the game fully as other online games have done before or making this pivot and releasing the Echoes Update. During this process, we quickly came to the realization that we’re making a superior game for both current and future players. We’d love to support Wayfinder for years. We have ideas for additional characters and new content, and we have the intent to do so if the players demand it and Wayfinder finds a new audience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/f8f6bfca807a83f44b2f88d390dddcece555e771.png[/img]

From everyone here at Airship Syndicate, our fans and supporters have been irreplaceable. All of the comments and support have helped push us to make Wayfinder the best it can be and to make sure it’s here to stay now and forever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/ecdcf868aa10dc784379eaa8c08fe7a16b1c7123.png[/img]

The future didn't look too bright for Wayfinder, the online fantasy RPG game from Darksiders, Ruined King: A League of Legends Story, and Battle Chasers: Nightwar creator Airship Syndicate, just a few months ago. Its publisher, Warframe makers Digital Extremes, announced late last year that it was closing its publishing division and, as a result, would no longer be involved with work on Wayfinder. Now, however, Airship Syndicate has regained control over its project, halted sales of the Early Access game, and recommitted to further development efforts.

notes.title: Wayfinder Transfer of Service Update
notes.notes:
Wayfinders,

We have reached an agreement with Digital Extremes to begin the transfer of Wayfinder to Airship in earnest. Until this moment, Digital Extremes has remained the publisher of record on Steam and PlayStation. We now begin the process of transferring those responsibilities to Airship.

We know Wayfinder had a rocky launch, but we still believe in the game and the world we created. 

When we founded Airship it was to create great games in compelling worlds, with memorable characters and adventures. With those core principles in mind, we've spent the last several months working behind the scenes, challenging some of the core ideas in Wayfinder and creating an experience that remains consistent with our standards and beliefs. We did this while keeping in mind that we want to respect our founders and excite new players - all while staying feasible as a business model for us as a new independent publisher. We plan to share these changes soon, but we aren’t quite ready. 

Due to these changes, we’ve turned off new sales of the game for the time being. Those who have purchased Wayfinder can still access and play as normal with no interruptions.

Airship is committed to keeping Wayfinder active and vibrant. There will be major changes, and major improvements, but we have no plans for it to disappear like so many online-only games we’ve all played and loved. We think Wayfinder can be something special, and be around to play forever.

Thank you so much for your support. Stay tuned to our social channels for more information in the next 4-6 weeks.

Airship Syndicate

[h2][b]Balance Adjustments 
[/b][/h2]
GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS

[h3]Defense Overhaul
[/h3]In this patch we’re changing the way damage reduction from Physical Defense and Magic Defense is calculated.

Previously damage reduction was calculated by comparing a Wayfinder's Physical or Magical Defense to the base Weapon or Ability Power of the attack hitting them. This caused two problems. 
Firstly, this method meant there was not a single damage reduction percent value to show players, as the amount of damage reduction granted by Defense varied from enemy to enemy and attack to attack.
Even worse, this method of calculation made damage more spikey. Low power enemies like fodder or low power attacks like multi-hits would have a lower base Weapon/Ability Power and thus percentage reduction against them would be greater. But the opposite was also true, with boss attacks and heavy strikes having drastically lower damage reduction.
For these reasons, we have changed how damage reduction is calculated. Now, rather than comparing defense to the base power of an attack, defense is compared to a standard value based on the enemy's Power Level. 

With this system, the damage reduction percentage given in the stats page is the percentage reduction against attacks from same-level enemies.
Damage reduction percentage will change slightly when fighting enemies at a higher or lower Power Level, but it will be far more consistent with this system than it was previously.

notes.title: Patch Preview: Performance Improvements
notes.notes:
Subtitle: Six Major Changes to Enhance Performance and Stability

It’s time to optimize! We hope players have been enjoying the first iteration of the Job Board Preview. We are actively reviewing and planning adjustments to the system based on the mountain of feedback provided by all of you. Our next patch will include quite a few job-related fixes and changes, thanks to the community’s help.

As we showcased in our Q1 Roadmap, this patch will primarily focus on optimizations rather than content. We remain committed to securing the foundation of the game, and we’ve heard players loud and clear: you want better performance, fewer disconnects, and a more stable experience. The team’s big hope with this patch is that we’ve made a significant leap forward in terms of the client’s overall responsiveness and stability.

[b]Shader Precompilation:[/b]
Upon startup, we will now perform shader precompilation right away, as opposed to when you encounter content. This will significantly reduce hitching, stuttering, and input lag when encountering certain abilities, enemies, and biomes.

[b]Skylight and Highlands Asset Optimization:[/b]
Our tech teams have conducted numerous passes of optimization in areas like Skylight and the Highlands, reducing dense amounts of geometry and assets. A major HLOD (Hierarchical Level of Detail) pass was completed to “trim the fat” of excessive assets causing unnecessary processing burdens.

[b]Lighting Overhaul:[/b]
We have overhauled the way we process lighting, reduced complexity, minimized overlapping lights, and removed shadows on light sources that were unnecessary. This has resulted in a significantly lower processor burden when rendering illuminated areas.

[b]Quality and Performance Mode Added for PS5:[/b]
This highly requested console feature will allow PlayStation 5 players the ability to choose between higher graphical fidelity or an improved frame rate, achieving a near-locked 60 fps.

[b]Improvements to Asset Loading:[/b]
We have increased the buffer period for asset streaming regions, which will result in significantly less hitching when traversing large areas with lots of details and players. This will have a greater impact on machines that are closer to our minimum requirements than on higher-end machines.

[b]Backend Inventory Optimizations:[/b]
Our netcode has undergone significant improvements to inventory tracking in an effort to reduce server and transaction loads. This includes optimizing the amount of player data sent to the server, cutting instances of required bandwidth in half in some cases. We hope this significantly reduces disconnects for players who have logged many hours into Wayfinder and have very large inventories (long playtime history = lots of histories and logs). We have also performed a major optimization of multiplayer data infrastructure, which will reduce server load, hitches, and potential disconnects when players with excessively large inventories join a server you are on.

As January comes to a close, we want to again thank all of our dedicated fans who have continued to show their love for Wayfinder with all the feedback posted every day, as well as welcome all of the new faces we are seeing around Evenor!

Our next patch preview will focus on some of the exciting UI and gameplay changes you can expect from Patch 0.2.4, coming in early February!

Hello Wayfinders and Happy New Year! The team is back and recharged from the holidays, and we are ready to introduce the next set of features into Wayfinder!

We discussed at the end of last year having more meaningful updates faster, and this is the first real test of that adjusted philosophy where we are releasing content a little earlier than “done” so we can solicit feedback before fully releasing it.

The goal of working alongside all of our players remains the same: Make sure things are both functioning as well as fun and rewarding. Going forward, we’ll be calling these events/features in this state “Previews.”

[h2][b]The Job Board Preview is LIVE![/b]
[/h2]
The goal of the Job Board Preview is to provide players with another source of XP for the player’s Wayfinder and Weapon, as well as their Reward Tower. It’s also a place where you can get some memory fragments, gloomstone shards, dyes, cosmetics, and more!

Do you find jobs fun? Do you have ideas for jobs? Did you find a bug associated with the board or the rewards? [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/ceea1ae81db684815298c7fc2bb1c5baa6f82cf1.png[/img]

[url=https://jobboardpreview.featureupvote.com/]https://jobboardpreview.featureupvote.com/[/url] !

[/h2]

As we discussed last year, we have a big year planned for 2024. [url=https://trello.com/b/RgnuBh4m/wayfinder-roadmap]We recently updated our public facing roadmap. [/url]

[/h3]When implemented, the Archetype Accolade track will have you earning bonuses such as increased max equipment level, affinity points, and archetype specific passives as you play with various Wayfinders. [/h3]They may be the fights you know and have memorized, but they will be designed to present an extreme challenge for players and in return have drastically increased accessory and crafting component drop rates, Mythic Rush echo variants, new accessory sets and Black Gloomstone drops to use alongside the increased Affinity Cap. In between these large releases we will continue to focus on hotfixing the game to improve performance + server optimizations, balance, bug fixes and more. 

2024 is the year we see our original vision for Wayfinder coming to reality. We’re incredibly excited about the future and as always thanks for playing and being a part of this growing and awesome community!

notes.title: v0.2- Eventide is LIVE!
notes.notes:
Patch 0.2 - Eventide

The team has been working tirelessly to prove to the world their capabilities and commitment to bringing Wayfinder as both Developer and Publisher. 

The result of that heroic effort - over 2,000 bug fixes, performance improvements, combat rebalances, Wayfinder reworks, system implementations, content enrichments, additional cosmetics and much much more. With that we say goodbye to Version 0.1 of Wayfinder, as this is indeed deserving of us moving to 0.2! 

[previewyoutube=zRSd1s12mnA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Important Notes: 
[/h2][list]
[*] This update is a total repackaging of all of our files and assets. Download and install may take longer than usual.
[*] When you start the game for the first time, shaders will recompile which may results in reduced performance for a minute or two before retuning to normal.
[*] The game now requires an SSD.

[/list]
[h2]Patch Highlights:
[/h2]
[b]Awakening System (Part 1) [/b]- A major implementation for late game progression for players in Wayfinder. Upon reaching maximum level, Players can collect & craft Awakening Stones to add a new echo slot, increase echo capacity, as well as buff to all of their stats on Wayfinders and Weapons. Right now the current cap is 3*. In the future we'll be expanding this system to 5* as well as implementing archetype levels and other horizontal progression for your Wayfinders and their entire archetype. 

[b]Performance[/b] - We know performance has been a huge pain point for many members of our community, this is the first of many patches were we’ll directly be working on performance + optimization. This patch delivers hundreds of improvements on backend optimizations as well as client changes that have a dramatic impact on overall performance. We aren't done with improving performance, but this should be a huge leap in the right direction. 

[b]Senja Rework[/b] - As the Last of the Iron Sisters and Champion of the Imperial Arena, we didn't feel as though Senja was packing the punch we envisioned. Senja players should expect some major improvements to Sejna’s mobility, durability and offensive capability! These aren't only stat adjustments, but sweeping buffs/reworks to her core kit of abilities. 

[b]Event Timers on the map[/b] - No longer do you have to guess when events are happening or how long world bosses will be up! Our v1 of this system has timer markers on the map. In the future we'll be adding names as well as more info there about drops, progress etc. 

[b]Rifle Subclass Reworks[/b] - The goal with this subclass rework is to incentivize creative loadout compositions, depending on the challenge Wayfinders face. Rather than have every rifle weapon essentially perform similarly asides from their weapon ability, we want each subclass to have a distinct utility to distinguish themselves.
	[list]
[*] Shotguns - Significant break power and close quarter splash damage
[*] 	Rifles -Mid-range Low break but high broken DPS
[*] 	Railguns - Long range single target burst  
[/list]
[b]Stat Rebalance[/b] - We want player builds to be diverse and interesting, with clear benefits for investing in the full spectrum of offered stats. Specifically Ability Power and Defensive stats were underperforming when compared to Weapon Power and Crits. To address this we are implementing some major buffs to AP builds, and fundamental improvements to Defensive stats as a whole. 

[b]Lost Zone Event items changes[/b] - Specific items in Lost Zones that may drop from a specific event now have a chance to drop in all events within that Lost Zone. This means that those hard to find crafting ingredients just got a little easier to get.

[b]New Wayfinder + Weapon Dye Tech[/b] - We love seeing the huge diversity of player expression with our style system and dyes, but more is always better! Take a look into the new Dye options to see additional slots for Wayfinder VFX, even more trim customization, and three new slots for Weapon Dyes!

[b]Updated Music and Combat Sound Effects[/b] - We are already very proud of the music and ambiance in Evenor, but prepare for even further immersion with loads of improvements to Combat feedback sounds (Hits vs Crits, breaks, deaths, dodges etc.) and a new music system. 

[b]Inventory Management and UI upgrades[/b] - Players will now have improved sorting functionality for their Echoes, ability to view Affinities and Echo slot types in shop/inventory lists, and sell multiple instances of items with a single input! We have laid the framework for Mass Tag + Sell/Dust with a single click as well as Multi-Crafting, so stay tuned as we look to add these and additional functionalities soon! 


[b]Underperforming Weapon Buffs[/b] - We want all weapons to be on a level playing field, with distinct strengths and weaknesses depending on the encounter. Sword & Shields as a weapon class are statistically less relevant compared to other weapon types, so there are a number of changes to weapons to bolster some of the less popular choices and give them a chance to shine. 

[b]XP Caches[/b] - XP Resonance Caches for Wayfinders and weapons are now enabled! When we rolled out the 300% XP Buff, we had mentioned that we'll be adjusted XP once again to account for these scrolls. We have reduced the overall gain from expeditions and hunts and put that difference in these XP caches. 

[b]Helper Coin Shop Update[/b] -  It has been incredible to see how many Wayfinders take advantage of the Helper Queue system to help fellow players push back the Gloom. We want to reward that collaboration even more with tons of new additions to the Helper Shop, including new items and resources, as well as exclusive cosmetics not sold in-game; all available for [i]FREE[/i].

[b]New Weapons [/b]- Five brand new weapons await crafting. Bastion, Bloodsong, Windmother’s Fang, Umbros and Voidbreaker!   

[b]Eventide Live Event[/b] - The citizens of Skylight are celebrating Eventide, but that means they’ll also need your help in making sure it’s the holiday the citizens deserve! Our biggest live event yet will be active in the weeks following this patch’s release and feature a vendor with exclusive housing items and cosmetics.  

[i]Eventide Known Issues: 
[list]
[*] Sometimes Lures will not be placeable at the Plunderfool event.
[*] Presents are not placeable under the Eventide Holiday Tree.
[/list]These 2 issues will be fixed Monday 12/18 and do not prevent you from earning Eventide exclusive cosmetics![/i]

[h3] [url=https://www.airshipsyndicate.com/wayfinder-updates/2023/12/12/eventide-patch-notes]The full 79-page, 27,430 word Patch Notes can be found here[/url]
[/h3]

[h2]What's in store for 2024?
[/h2]
As always thank you to everyone that has supported us when we announced, when we launched into Early Access and when we began our transition of service. We hope that this patch shows our continued commitment to Wayfinder. With the launch of Eventide, our team will be taking a much deserved break for the next few weeks. In early 2024 we'll return to our weekly/biweekly patch cadence. We're also going to be pausing adding additional MTX items (outside of Eventide themed items) to the store while we focus on v0.2 being a great new foundation.

These patches will includes fixes and balances changes as well as content. Rightfully people have asked about the things we promised in Season 2. By not being bound to a Seasons for the time being means we'll be able to quickly release content. We are truly just getting started, because In early 2024 you can look forward to:

Recently, we released Patch 0.1.9.0 that included some needed balance adjustments to a few weapons and an increase to Hellswarm’s ability. We also made a few fixes to the Reaver King boss fight as well as some quests. You can read up on the detailed list of [url=https://www.playwayfinder.com/en/news/patch-0-1-9-0-patch-notes]improvements and fixes[/url].

[h3]Community Hot Topics: XP & Patch 0.1.10.0[/h3][hr][/hr]We’ve heard you loud and clear. XP progression needs a few tweaks. While we had plans to wait until a future season to introduce a few changes at once, we’re going to fast-track some of those changes [b]today[/b] to get you leveling your Wayfinders and weapons faster!

While not a complete list, here are some changes that are [b]live today in Patch 0.1.10.0[/b]. Additionally, we’ll share some initial thoughts on future plans, yet to come.

[b]XP GAINS FROM NON-QUEST SOURCES IS TOO LOW[/b]

We agree. We’re going to be tuning these gains across the board. Also included in this patch will be increased XP in Hunts, creature kills (inside Lost Zones and Highlands) as well as fixing some enemies who previously gave no XP. We’ve also added modifiers based on the number of imbuements you have applied, meaning the bigger challenges will reward more XP.

[b]REWARD TOWER LEVELING AND ALT LEVELING IS SLOW[/b]

We also agree. The big thing that we had planned for Founder’s Season 2 is the Job Board. This allows you to quickly level up your Reward Tower by selecting missions you want to undertake for the day. We’re looking at releasing this along with XP scrolls sooner than FS2. In the meantime, we’ll be more than doubling the rate at which Reward Tower keys are gained in this patch. We’ll revisit this Reward Tower increase in the future when the Job Board has been released.

[b]ALTERNATE WAYS TO GET XP[/b]

We’re looking at new and exciting ways for players to get XP. One of the things we’ll be doing is rethinking the expedition bar. While this was always meant to fill up as you explored expeditions, we think we can do more to reward the level of activities you’re doing. If you come across 2-3 puzzles in a side room, you should get some good loot and XP for completing those. We’ll have more on how we’ll address these at a later date. We’re also finalizing plans for double XP weekends and hope to have those implemented soon.

While this is something we will continually be fine tuning to make sure it’s the best experience, here is a list of changes live now.

[b]Patch 0.1.10.0[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased XP gains from all enemies by 386%. This includes mini-bosses and bosses in Expeditions and Hunts.
[*] Increased XP from Expedition completion bonus by 237%.
[*] Increased Reward Tower XP from all repeatable sources by 325%. This includes opening chests, breaking resource nodes, collecting memory fragments, completing events, and completing Expeditions & Hunts.
[*] Added XP multipliers to each mutator slot. 10% bonus for one imbuement – 20% bonus for two imbuements – 30% bonus for three imbuements.
[*] Fixed a bug on the Expedition/Hunt completion screen that was displaying the incorrect XP gained.
[*] Fixed a bug with Wingrave's Divine Aegis upgrade at rank 2 resulting in exponential increases in damage.
[*] Fixed Tooth and Claw VFX being misaligned when sheathed.
[/list]NOTE: We’ll revisit this Reward Tower increase in the future when the Job Board and has been released.

Those are our immediate plans, but we will continue to look for ways to improve your XP experience—and please continue to let us know your thoughts on our [url=https://playwayfinder.carrd.co/]socials and Discord[/url] or [url=https://wayfinder.featureupvote.com/]Feature Upvote[/url]. We are listening!

[h3]Tips and Tricks[/h3][hr][/hr]Looking to get that little extra edge on your next Expedition? We’ve poked our busy devs to give you some tips and tricks that can help you on your adventures across Evenor!

[b]Wingrave: Righteous Strike, Wherever you Are[/b]

Keep in mind what kind of enemies you’re fighting and equip a ranged weapon or melee weapon accordingly! When performing a Righteous Strike with a ranged weapon, it is a spearing thrust. With a melee weapon, Righteous Strike becomes more of a traditional sweep attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/8690312930f9b189a31cf28a9f6cfda6d317ac35.gif[/img]

[b]Party Composition: Let’s get this Party Started[/b]

There’s no right or wrong when it comes to who is in your party, but there are certainly some advantages to a balanced group! Mix and match support heroes like Wingrave and Venomess with damaged focused weapons. Whether they are laying down the DPS or healing, the group is covered! If you don’t have Ven or Wingrave in your party, don’t fret – the power of Echoes can come in handy with max health and life steal attributes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/e63e83a0cef3c1aecdfcea4248aa5e7dfc029897.jpg[/img]
[b]Matchmaking: Matchmaker, Matchmaker, Please not a Match[/b]

Wayfinders are stronger together, but on rare occasions it can be advantageous to go at it alone. If you are trying to complete a specific objective in a Lost Zone or just want to explore the area at your own pace, try turning off matchmaking before accepting your Lost Zone selection. Matchmaking will default back to multiplayer, so you’ll never have to worry about turning it back on. Happy hunting!

[h3]Community Events[/h3][hr][/hr]It has been great to see Wayfinders participating in the community events and contests, including our first art contest! You can see the [url=https://www.playwayfinder.com/en/news/wayfinder-wednesday-4]winners and their stunning art here[/url].

notes.title: Mid-Season Update 2: The Reaver King
notes.notes:
Wayfinder,

The Reaver King is available tomorrow October 31 across all platforms.  In our biggest update yet, log in and explore a mysterious realm that has emerged, teeming with new formidable foes. 

[h3]Mid-Season Update 2: The Reaver King[/h3][hr][/hr][previewyoutube=7c8DqTBqPV0;full][/previewyoutube]
The way to Hollow Heart is open. Once a paradise of primal power and a place of worship to the Woodwen people, it too has fallen to darkness. Now the Reaver King has set his sights on the Beacon. If Skylight is to be saved, Aturach and his Hollow Ones must be slain.

This update brings with it new quests, weapons, improvements and more! 

[h3]Main Quests[/h3]

[b]The Hollow Heart[/b]

Back again to Deepwood Holt. Seek out Graymourn and Omen, who will set you on the path to the Wormwood Hunt.

[b]Wormwood[/b]

Wormwood stands between you and unlocking the power of a third imbuement slot. Get to Deepwood Holt to accomplish your quest.

[b]Roots of Evil[/b]

Return to Graymourn for one final request before you are ready to unlock the Reaver King Hunt.

[b]The Final Battle[/b]

You have what you need, Wayfinder. The roots have been severed. The Reaver King can now be challenged. Reach a Gloom Gate and start your Hunt against this foe.

[h3]Side Quests[/h3]

[b]Eclipse Questline[/b]

A mistake from Arsenal’s past has returned to haunt the Highlands. The Essence needed to forge a new weapon is up for grabs. Corrupted by a dreaded weapon of the Deep Eldren, the Weapon Master’s old protégé, Anson, has returned to consume all light and life in his path. Speak with Arsenal to hear what she has to share.

[b]Ring of Ashes Questline[/b]

A mysterious ring from the mythologized Kingdom of Ashes has been found after a thousand years. The Engineer believes it might be used to uncover arctech wonders lost to time, and perhaps, the Engineer’s own origins as well. Check in with him once you’ve located the ring.

[b]Painful Secrets Questline[/b]

Your help is needed by a friend in Deepwood Holt. Seeker Avala herself has begun glitching in and out of reality, bringing to light a secret Lord Halar has been harboring since those first days after the Fall. Seek Avala out to see what secrets are surfacing.

[h3]Lost Zones[/h3]

[b]The Hollow Heart[/b]

The Heart of the Woods is not only a place but a power. A pillar of this world. Older than humanity. Older than the Eldren. Older than even the Architects. Yet whatever primeval purity once was, has been carved empty by the Gloom. The Hollow Heart remains. And its corruption is spreading.

[h3]Hunts[/h3]

[b]Wormwood[/b]

Wormwood—first child of the Hollow Heart. Nature itself has been twisted by the foul will which awoke in the woods. Wormwood remains the mightiest of its spawn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/59e7e53e1a5430072fccc90e275a0c22d221ff1f.gif[/img]

[b]Reaver King[/b]

The Reaver King wants for a world where the roots of trees are watered with blood, and the wind itself is hungry and cruel. He has seen this world—his world—foretold in shadow. And he will stop at nothing to ensure its birth.

[h3]Weapons[/h3]

[b]Legacy[/b]

This ancient weapon was forged in the dawn of the world, before humanity existed. It was made for Eldren hands, and it burns with eternal light.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/f5b54fcf214f72a8eece009f68e688a501ab414b.gif[/img]

Ability: Phalanx - Protects the Wayfinder and all nearby allies with a Damage shield, absorbing all damage, and preventing impacts until the shield is broken. Increases magnitude of the shield for each Latent Power Pip consumed.

[b]Rose & Thorn[/b]

As deadly as they are beautiful, these weapons were once wielded by the legendary Blade Dancer of the Golden Aerie. Blood sustains the flowering petals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/48758c2092e8bfaeb19e92c69196b04ae8a73189.gif[/img]

Ability: Thorn Blossom - Slam into the ground, shooting thorns up from the ground in an area below the Wayfinder. Enemies hit will be inflicted with Rose Blossom for 10 seconds, taking additional damage each time they are hit.

[b]Eclipse[/b]

This weapon was forged in the vaults of the Deep Eldren and infused with the power of Shadow. It yearns to consume light and life.

Ability: Steel Vortex - Throws the axe to spin in a vortex in front of the Wayfinder, dealing damage multiple times before returning. Deals additional damage for each level of Momentum consumed.

[b]Nightshade[/b]

The Venomess designed many weapons for the Maze, but Nightshade she made for herself. Its needles are infused with the venom of the Orlake Wyvern, ensuring a swift and painful demise.

Ability: Wyvern’s Fury - Reloads the gun with an empowered clip. During this clip, the weapon is fully automatic and every bullet is infused to apply a stack of Poison on hit. Poison is a small DoT that stacks up to 20 times and deals damage over 6 seconds.

[h3]Community Live Stream[/h3][hr][/hr]Be sure to check out our second Community Livestream with Community Manager Sir_Snarf! Tune in tomorrow at 4 p.m. CT over on our official [url=www.twitch.tv/playwayfinder]PlayWayfinder Twitch channel[/url] or on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1171690/Wayfinder/]Steam Store Page[/url] to catch Sir_Snarf in action playing through the update!

The first pass of the inventory system did make a small impact, but we know there is a lot more we can do. We're also exploring ways to reduce load screens, including when you accidentally fall off the map or while traveling within Skylight.

[b]Q2: Is the content in "Call of the Void" what we can expect moving forward for Live Events?[/b]

A2: While Call of the Void was our first event, it’s not a blueprint for all future events. Our teams are hard at work reading the feedback from this event and are preparing the tech to bring you even more exciting experiences in the future. For example, our next event will feature THREE new weapons instead of one! Also in Founder's Season 2 we'll have an event featuring a special vendor. You’ll be able to earn exclusive rewards and more when you visit them.

[b]Q3: Where’s the big kitty (Grendel)?[/b]

A3: Grendel will claw his way into Founder’s Season 2! He will be available instantly with a Founder’s Awakened Pack or Exalted Pack, and earnable with a Founder’s Base or Initiate Pack. Make sure to keep an eye out for more info on Grendel!

[h3]Fan Art Contest Winners[/h3][hr][/hr]First and foremost, we want to give a great big thanks to all of you talented Wayfinders who participated in our very first fan art contest to show off your best spooky Gloom themed art! It was a joy to see your creations and we can’t wait to run more contests in the future. Congratulations to the winners!

A large congratulations as well to our honorable mentions, who will each be receiving 1,000 Runesilver!

notes.title: Wayfinder Wednesday #03
notes.notes:
Welcome back, Wayfinders!

It’s time for the latest from the teams in this installment of Wayfinder Wednesday!

This week, we are diving into:
[list]
[*] Mid-Season Update 1 and First Live Event
[*] Updates and Known Issues
[*] Community F.A.Q.
[*] Giveaway Winners
[*] Fan Art Contest
[/list][h2]Mid-Season Update: Call of the Void[/h2][hr][/hr]Wayfinder’s first mid-season update, Call of the Void, is live and brings with it a host of new challenges from the Gloom, our first ever live event, 250+ changes and adjustments, and the newest weapon for your arsenal, Juggernaut!

[previewyoutube=7cId6B7jj5w;full][/previewyoutube]
So how do you answer the Call? Let’s get down to looking at this latest content.

[h3]Limited-time Live Event[/h3]

Our Season update brought along something more than we anticipated, a stirring in the Gloom, and the citizens of Skylight are calling for your aid. Jump into Wayfinder’s first live event, team up with other Wayfinders and claim your rewards!

[h3]The New Live Event[/h3]
[list]
[*] Start Location: Commander Wolf - Skylight
[*] Requirements to Start/Unlock: Walking in Shadows - Main Story Quest Chapter 2 Part 1
[*] Duration of Event: End of October
[*] Quest Info: A number of Watchers have gone missing near strange portals in the Highlands–journey deep into the Void and put an end to the anomaly.
[*] Reward: The Dawning Hope Gloom Dagger
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/4893952a392323cbded777db5a9a130e55921e9d.jpg[/img]
[h3]The New Area[/h3]
[list]
[*] Name: Lost Zone - Void Dungeon
[*] Start Location: Highlands - Gloom Rift
[*] Requirements to Start/Unlock: Speak with Wolf in the Great Hall
[*] Quest Info: A new Lost Zone has appeared, and it is evident that the Gloom is strong within it. Please Wayfinder, explore this new location and ensure that we can protect Skylight from the threats eager to come out of it.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/e55a203402a060c8456bc8e57b96e1a2bc2c3e6c.gif[/img]
[h3]The New Quests[/h3]

[b]Quest 1[/b]
[list]
[*] Name: [i]Harbingers of Chaos[/i]
[*] Start Location: Ranger Davyn
[*] Requirements to Start/Unlock: None
[*] Quest Info: Aid Ranger Dayvn in his vendetta against the Geartooth, and stop the goblin clan before they awaken a slumbering primal power.
[*] Special Note: We have doubled Talon of Pyre’s spawn rate from every four hours down to every two hours.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/95fbcbfeeec18e79f0a92f8b8f64407187cb8e58.jpg[/img]
[b]Quest 2[/b]
[list]
[*] Name: [i]The Final Score[/i]
[*] Start Location: Kestrel
[*] Requirements to Start/Unlock: Fallen Archon
[*] Quest Info: Help Kestrel uncover the fate of her old partner, the Rook, a brilliant machinist whose machines threaten to bring Skylight to its knees.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/f8d16a97173f028b6b141ae9ae5d96aee85a482c.jpg[/img]
[h3]The New Hunt[/h3]
[list]
[*] Name: Bloodbore
[*] Start Location: The Bloodworks
[*] Requirements to Start/Unlock: The Final Score Quest
[*] Quest Info: A rampaging mechanical monstrosity designed by the infamous machinist, “the Rook”; left unchecked, the machine threatens all of the Highlands.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/33a9d43344e7eaa9ddd3e8c255b44d058c92f06d.jpg[/img]
[h3]The New Weapon[/h3]
[list]
[*] Name: Juggernaut
[*] Acquire Location: Arsenal 
[*] Weapon Info: Convert momentum into a powerful charge, pummeling all foes in your path and pulverize enemies with a earth shattering ground slam.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/e4ff5700595fd155943484c01e044ab32205e623.gif[/img]

[h2]“Call of the Void” Patch Notes And Known Issues[/h2][hr][/hr]Last Wayfinder Wednesday we shared Phase 1 and Patch 0.1.5.0 had gone live and the team is seeing great results in the overall experience since launching. You can check out those updates [url=https://www.playwayfinder.com/en/news/wayfinder-wednesdays-02]here[/url].

We’re still working hard to tackle issues as they arise and making sure to give the Feature Upvote asks the love they deserve. With the mid-season update and Patch 0.1.6.0, we have a lot of game updates that went live and you can take a look at the full list of updates [url=https://www.playwayfinder.com/en/news/call-of-the-void-available-now]here[/url].

This is our first mid-season update and we hope you enjoy the latest additions to the game.

Ready to jump headfirst into the threats the Gloom puts against you? Grab a Founder’s Pack now to instantly unlock Early Access, our first live event and team up with Wayfinders around the globe!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1171690/Wayfinder/

[h2]Community Live Stream[/h2][hr][/hr]Our team wanted to experience our first ever live event alongside you all, so we did! Sir_Snarf himself (also known as Alex) hosted our community stream where we played through the new content, looked at his apartment (we’re hiring a cleaner) and walked you through the fixes and improvements that came with this update. All from the comfort of Airship’s brand new studio!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/a1ba0242345b4754fcf313ad3200bb65b97c01e6.jpg[/img]
[h2]Community F.A.Q.[/h2][hr][/hr]With our dev teams hard at work on the backend, we wanted to make sure we are addressing some of the more general questions here. Thank you to everyone who provided their questions over on our socials!

[list]
[*] Q1: Will there be seasonal items available for sale?
[*] A1: While Evenor doesn’t share the exact same calendar as us, we’re happy to say that we’ll have fun and festive seasonally appropriate items in the coming months. 
[/list]
[list]
[*] Q2: Any Wayfinder updates currently planned?
[*] A2: We’re constantly monitoring the performance of all Wayfinders to make sure they feel the way they should. We know Senja has been a topic of discussion and we agree. There is a rework underway for her and we hope to have more details on it soon!
[/list]
[list]
[*] Q3: Are there plans to add new weapon types soon?
[*] A3: Yes! The team currently has our next weapon type in active development and we hope to unveil it to you all after Wayfinder moves into Free-to-Play next year.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Q4: You upped the Echo inventory limit, what about accessories?
[*] A4: We’ve seen some players asking and wanted to confirm that it is definitely not off the table. Right now our data supports the 100 accessories cap both in terms of performance as well as the average amount players are getting as they play, but the team will be watching the data closely and may possibly expand it in the future.
[/list]
[h2]Loadout Inspection Giveaway[/h2][hr][/hr]Thank you to everyone who participated in our recent giveaway! And extra congratulations to our winners: @pjuniorsan, @ensuidia, @Matracena_, @IalLantinette, and @Llaverion! Your loadouts really showed how impressive you Wayfinders have already become in the fight against the Gloom. Didn’t win this time? Keep reading to learn about our next opportunity to claim a prize!

[h2]Fan Art Contest[/h2][hr][/hr]Some of you let us know you were looking forward to a fan art contest, and we mentioned an update would be available in this Wayfinder Wednesday. We ABSOLUTELY want to see all your amazing art, and we’re happy to be officially kicking off our first art contest! Artists of all skills are welcome and with what we have already been seeing from the community, we can’t wait to see what you all come up with for this one. In need of some inspiration to get started? Take a look at these amazing pieces from @_ArcSin, @_PericraniuM_ and @Koud3x!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/4053fba7778b030e1000c0e815c1120cf6207257.png[/img]
[h3]Art Contest[/h3]

[b]Art Prompt[/b]: Your best spooky, Gloom-themed art

[b]Contest Rules[/b]
[list]
[*] Timeframe: October 11, 2023 - October 20, 2023 at 11:59 p.m. ET
[*] Winner Announce: October 25, 2023

[/list][b]Eligibility[/b]

[*] Must be appropriate, no NSFW content

[/list][b]Submission Location[/b]
[list]
[*] Pieces must be submitted as a comment on our Wayfinder Wednesday #3 X (Twitter) post with the hashtag #WayfinderArt
[/list][h3]Winners[/h3]

[b]3 Main Prize Winners[/b]
[list]
[*] 1st - 1 Exalted Founder’s Pack + 3,500 Runesilver
[*] 2nd - 1 Exalted Founder’s Pack

[/list][b]7 Additional Winners[/b]

[*] 1,000 Runesilver
[/list][b]All Participants[/b]

[i]*By providing your art in the form of a comment on the designated post, you are agreeing to allow the Wayfinder brand to use your art in current and future art related content pieces.[/i]

Get to creating Wayfinders, and we look forward to showcasing your art in our future content!

Our mid-season update is live, so get out there and show the Gloom that Wayfinders are stronger together. We will see you on October 25 for Wayfinder Wednesday #4!

notes.title: Wayfinder Wednesday #02
notes.notes:
Greetings Wayfinders,

It’s time for our second installment of Wayfinder Wednesday! If you missed our first one, be sure to check it out [url=https://www.playwayfinder.com/en/news/welcome-to-wayfinder-wednesdays]here[/url] where we shared exciting updates, addressed Frequently Asked Questions from the community and more!

This week we’ll dive into: 
[list]
[*] New Wayfinder Reveal
[*] First Ever Live Event and New Content
[*] Quality of Life Updates
[*] Patch 0.1.5.0
[*] Player Support 
[/list][h3]Tokyo Game Show 2023: Introducing Grendel[/h3][hr][/hr]During the thrilling weekend at Tokyo Game Show 2023, we unveiled our newest upcoming Wayfinder, Grendel. 

[previewyoutube=a_54ZR92n0o;full][/previewyoutube]
This fierce beast will be making a roaring entrance in Founder’s Season 2! Remember, if you purchase or already own a Founder’s Awakened or Exalted Pack, you’ll be able to take control of Grendel instantly! With an Initiate Pack, you can gain access to the components required to craft Grendel. Stay tuned for more details about Grendel and Season 2.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1171690/Wayfinder/

[h3]Call of the Void: Live Event and New Content[/h3][hr][/hr]While we’re releasing new content, we are continuously working on improving current gameplay to make your Wayfinder experience better. We’re thrilled to announce our very first live event – Call of the Void – along with an exciting array of new content! Let’s dive into your first look at this upcoming update. 

Omen and Wolf need you! Strange rifts are appearing across the Highlands, and we’re calling upon your courage and curiosity to join us in unraveling its secrets. Your mission is to explore these rifts, where untold mysteries and surprises await your discovery. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/2138d11329d2a5b36a14c5fb39ce3dccee29ebbb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/935949ad9924a46a8eedbd2a83c6d5e49c4bd163.jpg[/img]
We’re introducing 2 new quests to challenge your skills. One of these quests will have you brave the fires of chaos as you confront the formidable Talon of Pyre in [i]Harbingers of Chaos[/i]. [i]The Final Score[/i] unlocks the fearsome Bloodbore, a weapon that has been constructed in secret within the Mines and is prepared to stop Wayfinders in their tracks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/d838335be4e2468f7a627a2647141329de59afe1.gif[/img]

Venture into the eerie depths of a new Lost Zone, Gloom Dungeon, and introduce foes to your newest friend, a weapon we are affectionately naming, “Juggernaut”. Forged for the Balgrim Shaarak'uul in the Halls Below and claimed as spoils of war by the Archon Halavant. Few can withstand its crushing blows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/6d45aecc45b45df329dbe131c6cc98d894246e67.jpg[/img]
We’ve prepared an exclusive reward for those who complete the event while it’s active – a coveted Gloom Dagger skin, Dawning Hope! Are you up for the challenge?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315175/4893952a392323cbded777db5a9a130e55921e9d.jpg[/img]
The team can’t wait to share an in-depth look at this update in early October! Be on the lookout for the exact date when the update will be launched.

[h3]Quality of Life Updates: Phase 1[/h3][hr][/hr]In our first Wayfinder Wednesday, we shared a major inventory update that we are implementing in two phases. Phase 1 is now live and introduces a new feature called Echo Dust. Here’s a full breakdown of what Phase 1 accomplished:

[b]Phase 1[/b] 
[list]
[*] The Echo Fusion system has been overhauled.
[*] Players can now break down their Echoes into Dust.
[*] Using the Dust, players can increase the Rank of their Echoes.
[*] Fixed a bug causing Echoes to grant incorrect amounts of XP (now Dust) in fusion.
[*] Fixed a bug where Commander Creed’s Echo showed a different cost to equip than the actual cost.
[*] REMOVED: “Sort By Power” for Echoes. This has been removed until we implement a more informative version of this sort.
[*] There is now an item limit for Echoes (300) and Accessories (100).
[*] Added warnings for when players are approaching either item limit. When you have reached the limit, you cannot pick up anything else until you are back under the limit.
[*] Fixed Non-Romanized languages on the keyboard being nonfunctional in the social menu.
[*] Fixed Tooth & Claw, and Epitaph displaying rifle or shotgun skins.
[*] Accessories are now able to be sold at Venge’s Shop in Skylight!  
[*] WARNING: On first load of the SELL screen, equipped accessories display on the ALL panel and can be sold without warning the player. They do not appear on the ACCESSORY panel.
[*] All acquired Accessories will be sold at their intended cost per Accessory level.  
[*] Fixed an issue causing players to be unable to fast travel inside of Lost Zones.
[*] Fixed an issue where players would be disconnected during an Expedition or Hunt with the Firebombs imbuement active.
[*] Fixed an issue where Helper Coins were not being rewarded to the player as expected after completing Lost Zone Expeditions via Helper Queue.  
[*] Fixed an issue causing players to get stuck on a “Please Wait” screen while backing out of the Wayfinder Founder’s Pack menu while it was opening.
[*] Adjusted the priority quest to unlock Echo Fusion to unlock at the same time as the player unlocks the Echo system.
[*] Various localization updates and improvements.
[*] Fixed an issue where non-functional Echoes were populating in the Echo menu.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Accessory menu would display blank tiles.
[*] Fixed an issue causing Kyros' “Siphon Radiant” Ability buff to exceed its intended value of 10%.
[*] Reward Tower reward emote “Kiss of Venom” will appear in the players' inventory if/when unlocked. The player will see this in their inventory when equipped with Venomess.
[*] Fixed an issue causing Venomess’ Soothing Vapors Affinity Perk to not function.
[*] Soothing Vapors now correctly displays visual feedback that you are healing.
[*] Fixed an issue causing Venomess' Ultimate to fire off in the wrong direction.
[*] Fixed an issue causing masteries to be locked on Venomess.
[*] Night’s Maw Echo will always drop at its intended Echo type (“Rush”) and Level (15).   
[*] Talon of Pyre’s Echo will always drop at its intended Level (30).  
[*] Added the proper names of travel destinations to load screens.

[/list]Phase 2 from our last Wayfinder Wednesday will be implemented later during Early Access. Please stay tuned for more information.

[h3]Patch 0.1.5.0[/h3][hr][/hr]We also implemented a patch that addresses the following:
[list]

[/list]We’re listening to your feedback and appreciate the continued support as we continue to improve the experience. The team is just as excited about these updates as you are and we will make sure to provide more information as we have it.

Please continue to share any feedback or issues you’re encountering on our [url=https://wayfinder.featureupvote.com/]Feature Upvote[/url] page–or just drop by and vote for the features you’d like to see added!

[h3]Community F.A.Q.[/h3][hr][/hr]The team has been working hard to go through all of your support tickets! While there are still many to get through, the queue has decreased and the response time is getting faster. Thank you for your patience, Wayfinder! We wanted to take this opportunity to answer some more of your questions that we have seen come in. 

If I upgrade my Founder’s Pack, will I get the items that come in each tier?
